subject: Premium support bundle structure and volume credit plan
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@lumenai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenai.com
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Consolidating support + credits for upcoming commit

Hey Priyom,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team was impressed with the predictable latency and the routing fallback story. We're sizing our 2027 inference budget and want to consolidate support into one premium bundle rather than managing multiple SKUs. Two asks from my side:

- Can you outline a bundled SLA that covers: 99.9 / 99.95 / 99.99 uptime bands, faster response windows for Sev 1/2/3, and 24/7 escalation coverage?
- Given our projected token growth (est. 4x in 12 months), can you propose a volume credit plan (credits applied to overage or future invoices) and any commit-based discounts?

We're trying to get a single line item for procurement and will need an estimate to attach to the PO request by Aug 10.

Appreciate a clear proposal / bullets so I can take to finance.

— Sarah
Head of Platform Ops
LumenAI
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@lumenai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, procurement@lumenai.com
Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating support + credits for upcoming commit

Hi Sarah — great to hear the demo landed well. Attached is a first-pass support bundle (Redwood_Support_Bundle_v3.xlsx) and a short summary below. I pulled in Laura and Vanessa to confirm pricing bands and escalation ops.

Proposal (high level):
- Bundles: Base Support (99.9 uptime, business-hours triage), Premium (99.95, 24/7 triage, 4-hour Sev1 response), and Platinum (99.99, 24/7, 1-hour Sev1 response + named escalation).
- Pricing model: monthly committed capacity + per-token overage. Commit tiers at 1x / 2.5x / 5x projected baseline with stepped unit discounts of 10% / 18% / 27% respectively.
- Volume credits: 6-month lookback applied as a credit on next invoice for sustained overage above committed tier. Credits are capped at 30% of monthly invoice and can be rolled forward for up to 3 billing cycles (see SLA-Crediting-Terms-RED-v1.pdf).
- Escalation coverage: Platinum includes a single named escalation lead and quarterly on-call runbook review; Premium includes 24/7 escalation but no named lead.
- Conditions: longer-term commits (12+ months) unlock lower effective rates and more flexible credit rollforward.

Attachments: Redwood_Support_Bundle_v3.xlsx (breaks down banded pricing + example invoice math).

If this looks directionally right I'll ask LA to prepare a more detailed quote with the DL and PO language.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@lumenai.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating support + credits for upcoming commit

Looping in a few guardrails based on similar deals:

- Recommend a stepped credit schedule rather than a lookback-only model: 5% credit at 25–50% overage, 12% at 50–100%, 22% at 100%+. That gives the customer predictability and helps us limit downside.
- Minimum monthly commitment requirement for credits to apply: customers must maintain at least a 6-month rolling commit or credits convert to account-level invoice offsets only (no cash refunds).
- Rollforward: allow credits to roll forward up to 6 months for 12+ month commits; for shorter contracts cap at 3 months.
- Discount ceiling: do not exceed 30% effective discount vs list without exec approval. If the customer requests named escalation + 1-hr SLOs across all regions, price uplift should be explicit (we've seen 18–25% uplift).

I'll attach a short terms excerpt (SLA-Crediting-Terms-RED-v1.pdf) when we finalize. Priyom — ok to present the stepped credit schedule and the 12-month preferred pricing in the proposal?

—Laura
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@lumenai.com>
Date: Tue, 04 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Consolidating support + credits for upcoming commit

Quick operational note on escalation coverage that will affect pricing:

- 24/7 triage vs 24/7 named escalation: triage (basic) can be covered by our global ops at a modest uplift (~7%). Named regional escalation leads and guaranteed on-call overlap windows (e.g., primary responder within 60 minutes for all timezones) drive higher uplift (~15–22%).
- If LumenAI wants guaranteed 1-hour Sev1 across all regions, we need to allocate a dedicated rotational engineer per region — this is the primary cost driver.
- Recommend offering a hybrid: Platinum (24/7 triage + named escalation North America / EMEA) + premium add-on for APAC named lead. This keeps headline price competitive and lets procurement toggle APAC coverage later.

I'll provide the adjusted line items for the workbook; Priyom, Laura — flag if you want the APAC add-on modeled differently.

—Karthik
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Consolidating support + credits for upcoming commit

Thanks — this is helpful and close to what we need. A couple quick follow-ups before procurement will accept:

1) Can you convert the workbook into a single-line summary for our PO (total monthly committed cost, committed token allowance, expected overage credit formula)? That will go into our SOW appendix.
2) We like the stepped credit idea; confirm the maximum credit that can be applied in a single month (you mentioned 30% earlier). Is that a hard cap?
3) Can you issue a 30‑day pilot for Platinum (no commitment) so we can validate 1-hour Sev1 across our busiest regions before flipping a 12-month commit?

If you can get the single-line PO summary + confirmation on cap + pilot terms by Aug 8 we can move to PO preparation.

Thanks —
Sarah
Head of Platform Ops, LumenAI
